body:
`helper.get_book_cover_with_uuid` (cps/helper.py) and `helper.get_kobo_cover_source_path`
resolve the book with `calibre_db.get_book_by_uuid`, which applies NO filter (cps/db.py) —
unlike the numbered `/cover/<id>` route, which goes through `get_filtered_book` and therefore
`common_filters`. `cps/kobo.py`'s cover handler uses the same raw lookup.

A policy-aware alternative already exists and is used elsewhere:
`get_book_by_uuid_for_kobo(..., enforce_policy=True)` (cps/db.py).

So a Kobo cover request naming another user's restricted book's UUID is answered from that
book rather than refused. Pre-existing; found by an adversarial review of PR #1739 (which
asked explicitly whether its new cache policy could attach to "a different user's book" — the
caching change does not reach this path, but the underlying lookup does).

Smallest fix: use the policy-aware lookup in both UUID cover helpers.
title: Kobo cover lookup by UUID bypasses per-user visibility filtering
